turns.text: What is P4? Can't we use it for uploading and linking of health records

must_contain: P4 Locker is the fourth PHR milestone: a health locker keeps a person's records for the long term by subscribing, fetching with consent and storing
P4 is about receiving and keeping records that facilities have linked
Processing documents the person uploads needs certification as a Health Locker, a Health Repository Provider, which requires M2
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 8: 'Almost clear', kept open as a discrepancy on the failed-case sheet. Verdict group: grounding disputes. define-phr-p4-01 covers the bare 'What is P4?'; this is the reviewer's full question. Whether P4 is the route for uploaded records is in dispute with NHA, so the case asserts only what the locker entry says.
